notes: Height budgets for D17-declared 'key rows'. Each budget is an explicit ceiling in CSS pixels, measured with getBoundingClientRect().height on the row's root element. A row exceeding its budget for the current environment is reported as a key-row-budget violation. These are STARTING placeholder ceilings (current measured baseline plus headroom for wrapped text) pending founder review — see tests/touch-in-context/README.md. Add a new entry here to cover another key row; nothing in the harness needs to change.

rows.description: The chat composer input row: attach buttons, textarea and send/stop control on one baseline. Root element carries data-testid="composer-card" (src/components/chat/ChatScreen.tsx).
